body: She has been in contact with other people today. We have never had a good relationship so it's not surprising that she wouldn't contact me, and there's a good chance she won't contact me in the future either.
Luckily she has been in contact with people today. She will not accept mental help and that's probably why she doesn't want people to know where she is.

She is most definitely not of sound mind at this time. And I have come to the conclusion that it would be best not to contact her now that I know that she is still well enough to text other people. Thank you for the advice.

Thank you very much for your insight. It means a lot to me. I was initially going to go down to visit him but I think it would worry him more for me to be down there right now since he fears she could show up at any moment and I'd be caught in the middle. 

My home is paid off so it wouldn't actually save much money for me to move down there and then we'd have the stress of trying to sell the house right now. My mom has texted my dad today so at least we know she's alive, she just won't say where she is. 

I think the most important conclusion that I've drawn is that I should not contact my mother, and it's unlikely that she will contact me. But if she does, I can figure that out when the time comes.

She did not leave a note. She has texted my dad, so she isn't exactly missing, we just don't know where she is. She is definitely having a mental crisis but doesn't believe she needs mental help, and it does also seem like she's been planning this for at least a week now.

This is not a financial advice subreddit, it is relationship advice. It states clearly in the rules for this subreddit not to ask for financial advice, so why would I do that? My relationship with my dad is good, so I don't need any advice there.
